system.description:
You must be under the effects of a Sword Aura: Secondary to cast this jutsu. When you cast this jutsu, you end concentration of Sword Aura: Secondary as this jutsu takes its place. At the beginning of each of your turns, select one of the listed monochrome colors which your weapons color shifts to match, gaining the listed effects.

Black: Your weapons damage type becomes Necrotic. Additionally, damage your weapon deals cannot be healed for 1 minute unless by a S-Rank jutsu.

White: Your weapons damage type becomes Psychic. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with this weapon, they must make a Charisma saving throw becoming Inverted on a failed save.

| Sword Aura: Monochrome - Inverted. / An inverted creature has parts of their body which was struck seemingly painted over as those colors are shifted to be the opposite on the color spectrum. An inverted creature loses its inversion status at the end of each of their turns. An Inverted creature suffers the following effects. / Inverse Strengths. Their Ninjutsu ability score becomes Wisdom. Their Taijutsu Ability score becomes Intelligence and their Genjutsu Ability score becomes Strength for the duration. / Inverse Defense. Their AC is used in place of all saving throw bonuses. Their highest Saving throw bonus is used in place of their AC. |
